items.title: Evolution and support

about.title: Engineers who stay for the unglamorous part.
about.body: We are an engineering team with more than five years building custom systems across industries — not only aviation. Discovery of the real process, design, implementation, and evolutionary maintenance. That is the method we used on every Frassi system: tours, ERP, and the institutional site.

items.q: Do you take over systems already in progress?
items.a: Yes. We audit what exists, say what can be kept, replaced, or rewritten, and pick up without stopping the operation. That is how we work when a previous vendor is gone.

items.q: How soon can a project start?
items.a: Usually one to three weeks after signing. We begin with a short discovery that sets scope, milestones, and measurable deliverables before the team scales.
Yes. We deliver for operators in the Americas — aviation clients included. Billing follows the engagement.
Fixed price when the work is known, a monthly retainer if the system will keep evolving, or time and materials when we still need to investigate. Discovery first, then a concrete proposal.
The client. We can sign an NDA before any technical conversation. Contracts assign intellectual property of deliverables, documentation, and repositories to you.
Yes. Behind your brand, inside your team, or as an external vendor. We do not compete for the client or the mark.
Maintenance, evolutionary support, and a response SLA. Most of the systems we ship stay with us for years — Frassi included.
